arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Frank argued courts must align counsel interests with class members.
Mr. Pincus argued no rule bans settlements paying only third parties.
Mr. Lamken argued policy questions belong to Congress or the Judicial Conference.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the limits of federal class action settlements. the sides that brought the case argue courts must reject deals that pay only third parties. the opposing sides argue courts may approve such deals if they serve the class's interests.
